title: Reproducing the 1–29 Oct 2026 headline for Pakistani Punjab

sum.label: S-NPP + NOAA-20 + NOAA-21, all rows: the press method (a naive sum of satellites, not comparable across years)

card_note: The card shows our counts either way.
per_satellite_filter: quality rule, no type screen in either year (NRT files have no type field); 1–29 Oct, Punjab; shown side by side, never stacked

changes.naive_sum_label: a naive sum of satellites, not comparable across years
changes.note: 2019 is the press's comparison year; the S-NPP 2018–25 range is shown beside it

wording: Neutral wording, Pakistan only, no country comparison.
approved: Hasnain, 8 Nov 2026: 'Run without it' - his answer to 'Run P04's tests before the checker's P04-CL report arrives?' (DECISIONS.md, commit 9833fdd; change log entry 2, commit 5a9a241)
filters: test counts: every row (no quality or type filter), Punjab polygon, every UTC day of 1–29 Oct 2026, where 'all rows' means rows that pass c08.ingest.parse_frame's data contract, with exact duplicates removed (same platform, UTC time, latitude, longitude and version), from the FIRMS area-API download box recorded with each file (data/manifest.json, bbox) intersected with the province polygons. Demonstration counts (2019 and 2018–25): quality rule, no type screen, from FIRMS's Pakistan country file (standard stream, c08.ingest) intersected with the same province polygons (the same source as G03's bridge training rows). 'Pakistan' means all seven geoBoundaries ADM1 polygons (Azad Kashmir, Balochistan, Gilgit-Baltistan, Islamabad Capital Territory, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Punjab, Sindh).

rules.within: |count - press figure| <= 20% of the press figure (13,241 for the sum, 4,562 for S-NPP), unrounded
rules.gap_days: listed gap days and days with no row are reported beside the counts, not removed

missing_days_list_archive.used_for: the bridge's complete training months (P01 rule) and G04's archive gap days
